name: cutemarkets-cookbook
what_it_holds: Runnable Python/TypeScript recipes for the CuteMarkets commercial options-data API, organized by workflow: options-chain scanners, historical contract reconstruction, an explicit 'earnings-implied-move' recipe, and quote-quality checks. VERIFIED via README: requires signup and a paid API key at cutemarkets.com; no data or precomputed results are committed in the repo itself — it is documentation for calling a paid live API.
why_useful: The earnings-implied-move recipe (straddle-based) is a directly reusable formula/method for building our own ABNB 5-Nov implied-move calculator once fed our existing Yahoo/Bloomberg options chain, even without the paid API subscription.
duplicate_of_holding: we already hold current Yahoo options chains + a licensed Bloomberg options workbook; this only supplies a formula, not new data
themes: Options and event-move tooling: historical option chains (CBOE samples, ORATS-like), earnings implied-move calculators, IV term-structure datasets, earnings-drift datasets
wildcard: a sell-side analyst covering online travel who assembles con
why_all: The earnings-implied-move recipe (straddle-based) is a directly reusable formula/method for building our own ABNB 5-Nov implied-move calculator once fed our existing Yahoo/Bloomberg options chain, even without the paid API subscription.

Gives a ready-made implied-move calculation recipe (straddle-based) that could be pointed at ABNB's own option chain around the 5 Nov print instead of hand-rolling one from the Yahoo chain already held -- but note CuteMarkets itself is a commercial data vendor, so free access may be limited (check ToS/pricing before relying on it).
